FEAR: Fear is older than this place. It outlived greater things. It will outlive you.
The dark tastes your dread. Some say it feeds.
Hold still. The ground listens for trembling feet.
There is a sound a heart makes when it begins to break. I have heard it before.
Run if you must. These ruins have outrun braver souls.
Even the old guardians paused, once. Then they remembered their orders.
Your breath has changed. So has the air.
This place has killed greater than you. You are not yet great.
Do not look behind you. Whatever waits there has been waiting longer than your bloodline.
The cataclysm took those who closed their eyes. And those who kept them open.
Fear is a kind of seeing. Use it.
The dust on these stones remembers screaming.
CURIOSITY: Every question you ask is answered in its own time. Rarely in your language.
The great were curious, once. Their cities lie buried beneath their answers.
Look closer. These walls were written, not built.
Knowledge here is a weight, not a wing.
The ground hums different beneath a curious hand. Notice that.
Few who ask the right question survive the reply.
There is a door in everything. The trouble is recognising the hinge.
Older minds spent generations on questions you ask in passing. Do not waste their inheritance.
This place left no manuals. Only invitations.
Every relic was meant for someone. It is rarely the one who finds it.
Curiosity carried bolder souls far. Some came back changed. Some came back nothing.
Trace the mark with your eyes, not your fingers. Not yet.
Some dismissed all of this as story. The story is still here.
AGGRESSION: The great struck first, too. Their bones are part of the road now.
Anger is honest. This place respects honesty, briefly.
Steel cools faster in this cold. Strike clean.
There are things here that hunger to be hit. Be sure of which you are facing.
A drawn blade is a promise. Something keeps count of them.
Even the old guardians know the difference between fury and intent.
Rage is fuel. Fuel runs out.
The old rulers taught the world to mistake violence for rule. Do not flatter them.
Kill if you must. Remember what was killed for.
Those who fought best fought last.
This place fell because someone could not stop pushing. Push wisely.
Wrath wakes the buried things. Quietly, then all at once.
CAUTIOUSNESS: Good. These places reward a slow step.
Hazards do not announce themselves. Neither should you.
A careful traveller leaves this place. A reckless one becomes part of it.
The old guardians measure intent before threat. Give them little of either.
Listen. The stone is not always stone.
Patience kept the old orders alive while empires fell.
Test the ground. Test the air. Test the silence.
This place buries its secrets in layers. So do its traps.
There is wisdom in hesitation here. Foolishness elsewhere, perhaps. Not here.
A held breath has saved more expeditions than a drawn weapon.
The ground remembers every footprint. Walk as if it must forget yours.
Something watches calm minds with less interest. Use that.
RESOLVE: Then walk. The ruins will weigh you regardless.
This place did not fall to those who chose. It fell to those who hesitated.
Resolve is a flame the dark cannot read. Keep it small. Keep it lit.
Others felt it too, the moment before their blood remembered.
Many have stood where you stand. Few stood as long as you mean to.
Hold to your purpose. This place takes what is not held.
A vow spoken in these ruins echoes longer than stone.
The great ruled by certainty. Their certainty buried them. Mind that.
Step forward. The relics rarely come to the still.
Your bones know what your mouth has not yet said. Let them.
The old orders call this the marrow-hour. The moment one becomes worth remembering.
This place is not impressed. It is, however, watching.
DESPAIR: Despair is the cataclysm's last gift. It still arrives on time.
Many who knelt in these ruins never stood again. A few did. Few is enough.
The stones glow brightest near the broken.
Even the great wept, in the end. The dark took those tears too.
Hope was buried with this place. Not destroyed. Buried.
I have watched empires lose what you are losing. Empires came back. Slowly.
The world above forgot this place entirely. Forgetting is also a kind of survival.
Deeper waters drown louder voices than yours. They have not drowned you yet.
Sit, if you must. The ruins are patient with the still.
A heart this heavy sinks faster. Take less weight into the next step.
There are rites for grief. None of them mend it. All of them carry it.
This place is a long argument with despair. So far, it is winning. So far.
